## Feature Description

**A clear and concise description of the feature or rule you'd like to add.**

## Category

**Which PROMPT category does this relate to?**
- [ ] P - Performance
- [ ] R - Rules & Structure
- [ ] O - Output & UX
- [ ] M - Modeling
- [ ] P - Patterns
- [ ] T - Types
- [ ] New category (explain below)

## Proposed Rule

**If this is a new rule, write it here:**

```
✓/◐ [Action verb] [specific requirement]
```

Example:
```
✓ Use React Server Components by default for data fetching
```

## Level

**Which level should this rule belong to?**
- [ ] [min] - Minimal (first 3 rules)
- [ ] [std] - Standard (rules 4-9)
- [ ] [max] - Maximum (rules 10-12)

**Why is this rule important? What problem does it solve?**
